description: The file defines functions related to tensor dimension ordering and manipulation, particularly the 'order' function for reordering tensor dimensions and related helper functions and classes.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: A tensor class with internal level and device information, supporting positional dimensions.

classes.name: Dim
classes.description: Represents a single dimension, possibly with first-class dimension object.

classes.name: DimEntry
classes.description: Represents a dimension entry, including positional and None entries.

classes.name: DimList
classes.description: A list-like structure for handling multiple dimensions.

methods.name: DimEntry _wrap_dim(arg: Any, orig_ndim: int, allow_none: bool = True)
methods.description: Converts various dimension representations (Dim, int, or None) into a DimEntry object.

methods.name: torch.Tensor order( tensor_or_dim: Union[torch.Tensor, Any], *dims: Union[Any, Sequence[Any]] )
methods.description: Reorders tensor dimensions or creates a tensor from specified dimensions, supporting flattening of groups of dimensions.

ctags.name: _wrap_dim
ctags.pattern: /^def _wrap_dim(arg: Any, orig_ndim: int, allow_none: bool = True) -> DimEntry:$/
ctags.signature: (arg: Any, orig_ndim: int, allow_none: bool = True)
